data.name: Aiz
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-Z-A', which means to help, support, or assist. In Islamic history, 'Aiz is associated with the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his brothers who sold him into slavery but later regretted their actions and sought his forgiveness. The name Aiz symbolizes the power of repentance and the importance of seeking forgiveness.

data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Aiz are creative, emotional, and expressive. They have a strong intuition and are natural problem-solvers. They are also compassionate and caring, making them great supporters and helpers to others.
